feat-convert-insightsbookingservice-to-u.reason: At merge commit 967442892a, getBaseConditions in packages/lib/server/service/insightsBooking.ts returns `authConditions` bare, and the combined case is `(auth) AND (filter)` without outer parentheses. PR #22619 (feat: add hourly booking charts, commit e7535b9db3, 2025-07-21) changed it to `((auth) AND (filter))`, `(auth)` and `(filter)`, so a caller appending AND no longer changes precedence. Every later version kept the parentheses (checked through the rename to InsightsBookingBaseService.ts and the move to packages/features/insights/services/). The Cal.diy refactor (#28903, 2026-04-15) later deleted the insights service entirely, but the fix came first.
